3 000 caractères au maximum par aptitude: Up to 3,000 characters per feature and 6,000 per description. Text is imported without formatting (bold, tables), but line breaks are kept.
Aptitude : le nom de l’aptitude. Texte :: Feature: the feature's name. Text: what it does. There are 4 empty rows at level 3 and 2 at other levels: use one per feature and leave the rest empty. If you need more, copy a row of the same level.
Chacun peut remplir une partie (par exem: Everyone can fill in a part (for example their own subclass) and import it. Only an entry's author and the GM can replace it afterwards.
Commencez par l’onglet dont votre groupe: Start with the tab your group needs (often Subclasses). No need to fill in everything: only completed entries are imported.
Dans une lumière faible ou les ténèbres: In Dim Light or Darkness: you can turn Invisible as a Bonus Action (until you take an action, Bonus Action or Reaction), and you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.
Des barbares qui puisent leur rage dans: Barbarians who draw their rage from the storm.
Description : quelques lignes. Équipemen: Description: a few lines. Equipment: option A equipment, comma-separated, quantity first (e.g. “Carpenter's Tools, 2 Torches, Traveler's Clothes”). gp: option A gold. Option B (50 GP) is handled by the app.
Dons (dons d’origine, généraux, styles d: Feats (origin, general, fighting styles, epic boons
En rage, vous gagnez la résistance aux d: While raging, you have Resistance to Lightning damage.
Enregistrez au format Excel (.xlsx), san: Save as Excel (.xlsx), without renaming the tabs.

La colonne id, les noms des onglets et l: The id column, tab names and the header row. Without an id, the app creates a new entry instead of completing the book's.
Le texte de vos livres reste dans votre: Your books' text stays in your adventure: only people with its code can see it.
L’app connaît déjà toutes les sous-class: The app already knows every Player's Handbook subclass, background, feat, fighting style and epic boon (names, levels, abilities, skills…). Only their text is missing, which the app can't provide. Use this file to copy it from your book, then import it into the adventure in one go: the whole group then sees it in the builder and on sheets.
Ne remplissez que les colonnes indiquées: Only fill in the columns listed in the table below. Type or paste the text from your book. For a line break inside a cell: Alt + Enter (Windows) or Option + Enter (Mac).
Ouvrez l’aventure (onglet Aventure d’une: Open the adventure (a sheet's Adventure tab, or the GM screen) › Books & creations › Import a file › choose this file. The app shows how many entries were imported and how many are still empty.
Pour vos propres créations seulement : u: For your own creations only: one row per entry, empty id column. Codes are listed below.
Proposé aux historiques et au don d’orig: Offered to backgrounds and the human origin feat.
Proposé dans le choix de la faveur épiqu: Offered in the epic boon choice, at level 19.
Proposé dans le choix du style de combat: Offered in the fighting style choice (fighter, paladin, ranger).

Texte : la présentation de la sous-class: Text: the subclass overview (a few lines). Always-prepared spells: only if the book gives a spell table for the subclass, one line per character level, as “3: Bless, Cure Wounds”, with spell names as they appear in the app.
Texte : l’effet du don (obligatoire pour: Text: what the feat does (required for it to be imported). Prerequisite: check or complete. +1 from: if the feat increases an ability, the codes separated by commas (e.g. “for, dex”); otherwise leave empty.
Une fois par tour, quand vous touchez en: Once per turn, when you hit while raging, the target takes 1d6 Thunder damage.
Une sous-classe sans aucun nom d’aptitud: A subclass with no feature name, a background with no description or equipment, or a feat with no text is ignored: it stays “to fill in” in the app.
Vous pouvez compléter le fichier et le r: You can complete the file and re-import it as often as you like: a re-imported entry replaces the old one. To start from the latest version, use Export to Excel in the app.
